note: Golden yield vectors for LuckyProtocol v3 (PROTOCOL-v3.md §3). Shared byte-identical by the Rust indexer and luckyprotocol-app; both test suites assert them. Only the last hex char of `hash` matters: 'f' → 500, 'a'..'e' → 100, '0'..'9' → 21. Input is lowercased first, so an uppercase 'F' also yields 500. One row per entry in the spec's golden table.
